principles: Gmail START must be provider-acknowledged before substantive mutations.
Each tranche gets a realistic task-specific end window estimated from actual scope, uncertainty, CI/tool latency, and known human gates.
The START mail communicates scope plus the estimated local end window.
There is no artificial minimum duration and no requirement to fill an estimated window.
Do not stop merely because an estimate elapsed while machine work can still materially reduce uncertainty.
If the end estimate becomes materially non-credible, send at most one concise update when useful and revise the durable estimate.
The same active assistant turn owns the normal tranche from START through work and Gmail END.
Gmail END success requires provider message id plus SENT readback and durable CLOSED receipt.
Only after END acknowledgement may ChatGPT show the short Gmail pointer.
Usable product/checkpoint progress is the metric; elapsed time is not.
limitations: The estimate is advisory, not a promise or background-execution commitment.
This policy cannot retroactively rewrite past tranche records.
ChatGPT does not continue after the turn ends; resident BCP components may continue independently where implemented.
